items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Me and Mike Casimir was there, a drum player. We sat in with the band and played a little.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was pretty good. Me and Mike Casimir was there, a drum player. We sat in with the band and played a little. It was good, I would say. And I was up in Scotland, we went up there with the band and played there.
